{{Quote|Their engineers, the Zuguruk, are loyal, but they build far too many burial mounds and too few battleships.|[[Sorzus Syn]]|<ref name="BoS" />}}
The '''Zuguruk''' were a caste of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that originated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] within the [[Stygian Caldera]]. The second-highest caste in the Sith traditional system, the Zuguruk acted as [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]], and they were responsible for constructing [[Burial/Legends|burial mounds]] and [[Warship/Legends|battleships]] for the Sith.

==Biology and appearance==
As a subspecies of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the Zuguruk hailed from [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]],<ref name="BoS" /> a cold and dry<ref name="wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031002korriban|text=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls|int=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in a region called the [[Stygian Caldera]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The Zuguruk were quite similar to other castes within the Sith species: [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in form, with their skin spanning [[Color/Legends|hues]] from crimson to obsidian. Unlike the other subspecies, at least some of the Zuguruk had [[Human/Legends|Human]]-like hands with five digits,<ref name="BoS" /> instead of the usual tridactyl hands.<ref name="LTotS:Ptn">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pantheon]]''</ref>

==History==
Around [[6900 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|Sith Kingdom]] was conquered by a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[exiles]]. Under the reign of the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], High General [[Ajunta Pall]], the Zuguruk continued to fulfill their duties. However, [[Sorzus Syn]], one of the other twelve leading Dark Jedi, thought their new [[Sith Empire/Legends|dark side empire]] needed a powerful [[Navy/Legends|starfleet]] rather than architectural landmarks. Syn intended to convince Pall of the need to redirect the Zuguruk's effort, threatening to remove him from his position of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] if he refused.<ref name="BoS" />

Shortly before [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] started the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], he had Zuguruk loyal to him set up a projector to show [[Gav Daragon]] a map of the Sith Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="fall2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 2]]</ref>

==Society and culture==
Within the Sith heavily hierarchized society, the Zuguruk were tasked with the design and construction of machines, engines and buildings. Before the Dark Jedi's arrival, these Sith [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] focused on building [[Burial/Legends|tumuli]]. Under the influence
of Sorzus Syn, they were redirected to the conception of [[Warship/Legends|battleships]] in support of the new Sith Empire's belligerent ambitions.<ref name="BoS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zuguruk first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|fourth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]'',<ref name="GAotS4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]], illustrated by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[January 8]], [[1997]].<ref name="Publication">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54593/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996_4|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996) #4}} {{C|First printing}}</ref> They were first identified as Zuguruk in ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', a [[2012]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="BoS" />

The picture of a Zuguruk featured in the ''Book of Sith'' depicts him with [[Human/Legends|Human]]-like, five-fingered hands,<ref name="BoS" /> while the Sith were supposed to be a tridactyl species.<ref name="LTotS:Ptn" />
